產生器與我們的宇宙: 跟你最近見過的一些生物比起來，這位算是相當正常了，只不過牠的頭似乎是個圓柱體。

Generator and the people of our: The man is not interested in idle conversation. He's only interested in the skimmer.
產生器與我們的宇宙: 這個人沒興趣閒聊，他只在乎那台沙漠飛車。

Generator and the people of our: You have no way or reason to kill this being.
產生器與我們的宇宙: 你沒有辦法、也沒有理由殺掉這個生物。

Generator and the people of our: You are standing against the protective barrier encircling Ulence Flats. Due to the fact that you are land-based, you are not able to pass.
產生器與我們的宇宙: 你正靠在圍繞尤倫斯荒原的防護屏障上。由於你是徒步行動，沒辦法通過。

Generator and the people of our: He wants you to follow him.
產生器與我們的宇宙: 他要你跟著他走。

Generator and the people of our: The fresh air helps you snap out of the stupor which that foul brew was responsible for.
產生器與我們的宇宙: 新鮮空氣讓你從那杯難喝飲料造成的恍惚中清醒過來。

Generator and the people of our: Ulence Flats is a typical example of some of the frontier settlements that sprang up in the early days of the Outer Zone exploration several years ago. Unfortunately, this attracted many unsavory individuals looking to make a quick buckazoid. Caution is advised.
產生器與我們的宇宙: 尤倫斯荒原是幾年前外域探勘初期冒出來的典型邊境聚落之一。可惜的是，這也引來不少想撈快錢的不三不四人物，建議小心行事。

Generator and the people of our: Turning the key does no good since the skimmer was programmed to get here and go no further.
產生器與我們的宇宙: 轉動鑰匙也沒用，這台飛車被設定成只能開到這裡，沒辦法再往前了。

Generator and the people of our: There are couple of other craft here which might belong to the beings inside this building.
產生器與我們的宇宙: 這裡還有幾台其他的飛行器，可能是這棟建築裡那些生物的。

Generator and the people of our: The sand skimmer is a one-passenger mode of transportation and it looks like it has skimmed quite a bit of sand in its time. On it is a panel which has a small readout, currently dark, and a keyhole without a key in it.
產生器與我們的宇宙: 這台沙漠飛車是單人座的交通工具，看起來已經在沙地上跑過不少路了。上面有一個面板，裝著一個目前暗著的小顯示器，還有一個沒插鑰匙的鑰匙孔。
